listing.name: Mushihimesama Futari Ver 1.5 — futari_realcomp (springah)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream explicitly in development, not shippable; beta reportedly ran attract, menus, NormalPlay, Training, saves and native audio, with known defects. macOS M3Max shell/title boot is a separate bounded milestone, not campaign completion. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own Xbox360 MushihimesamaFutari Ver1.5 dump with title/shell/two game modules. Exact accepted region/revision and executable/module digests require upstream configs/status inspection.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Source build_win.sh or build_win_dll.sh with GitBash clang/lld; matching workbench additionally needs XDK9328. Linux build_linux.sh and macOS build_mac.sh are development routes with external dependencies/decomp tree; no shipping runtime package established.

warnings: Upstream explicitly in development, not shippable; beta reportedly ran attract, menus, NormalPlay, Training, saves and native audio, with known defects. macOS M3Max shell/title boot is a separate bounded milestone, not campaign completion.
